1almywf:186: Real efficiency means AI independently completes large chunks of work, humans only do parameter- and style-level tuning, and the produced code is maintainable; fake efficiency means frequent interaction, re-explaining after every small change, needing 50%+ manual adjustment after generation, and developers still bearing the full cognitive load. The correct metric should be "number of human interventions before requirements go live", not adoption rate or code volume. Long conversations also cause "human-machine window asymmetry"—AI remembers hundreds of thousands of tokens of history, while humans remember only the last 3-5 turns, and the repository eventually becomes a "cognitive debt" that only AI understands.
